limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not fully exclude that mechanical constraints on DNA during nuclear deformation also contribute to DNA damage.
The exact cytoplasmic factors causing DNA damage upon NE opening were not identified.
The in vivo relevance of NE opening in immune and cancer cell migration was not directly tested beyond ear explants.
The role of ESCRT III in NE resealing was primarily shown using siRNA knockdown, which may have off-target effects.
The study focuses on a limited set of cell types (mDCs, hDCs, HeLa, RPE-1) and may not generalize to all migrating cells.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
